name: What should I bring or wear to my first LIFT class?
description: Wear comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes; bring a water bottle. All lifting equipment is provided for LIFT classes.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring or wear to my first LIFT class?

acceptedAnswer.text: For your first LIFT class at Cave Training, we recommend wearing comfortable athletic clothing that allows for a full range of motion. Closed-toe athletic shoes are essential, preferably with a flat sole for better stability during lifting. Bringing a water bottle to stay hydrated is also advisable. You might also consider lifting shoes or a belt as you progress, but these are not necessary for initial classes. All necessary equipment, such as barbells and dumbbells, is provided.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wear comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes; bring a water bottle. All lifting equipment is provided for LIFT classes.
